currentContext.business: Odigma Consultancy Solutions Limited is a full-service digital marketing company offering website/technology development, SEO/SEM, social media, programmatic advertising, video and content marketing, ORM, and email marketing, alongside newer Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) offerings for AI-driven search discoverability. The Company continued its operations as a digital marketing agency and domain registry service provider, with no change in the nature of its business during FY2025-26. It serves clients across real estate, healthcare, food and beverage, e-commerce, manufacturing, education, and finance from a presence spanning 10+ Indian cities.

risks.risk: Talent retention in a competitive hiring environment
risks.note: The Company describes its employees as its key strength and differentiator and operates 'in a highly competitive environment,' making attraction, development and retention of skilled digital-marketing talent a structural dependency for service delivery.

The Chief Financial Officer role changed hands within the year (Ms. Guddi Bharatbhai Chauhan stepped down effective March 26, 2026; Ms. Saumya Milanbhai Yagnik was appointed CFO w.e.f. March 27, 2026), reflecting turnover risk in a critical management position.

The newly incorporated wholly-owned subsidiary, Odigma FZE LLC (Sharjah, UAE), had not commenced business operations and had no audited financial statements as of March 31, 2026; consequently the Company did not prepare consolidated financial statements for FY2025-26, limiting visibility into the international expansion.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: A Bengaluru-founded, full-service digital marketing agency and domain registry service provider serving 150+ clients across India since 2010.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Odigma Consultancy Solutions Limited is a full-service digital marketing company offering website/technology development, SEO/SEM, social media, programmatic advertising, video and content marketing, ORM, and email marketing, alongside newer Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) offerings for AI-driven search discoverability. The Company continued its operations as a digital marketing agency and domain registry service provider, with no change in the nature of its business during FY2025-26. It serves clients across real estate, healthcare, food and beverage, e-commerce, manufacturing, education, and finance from a presence spanning 10+ Indian cities.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Global digital marketing and advertising industry is in a consequential growth phase driven by rising internet penetration, mobile adoption, and an AI-first reimagining of brand-audience engagement
- AI Overviews and generative search are reshaping search behaviour; brands not optimised for AI-generated answers risk losing discoverability, driving demand for AEO/GEO services
- Client evaluation of agencies is shifting from awareness-based to outcome-based marketing, with clients demanding measurable ROI and transparent attribution
- The DPDP Rules (notified November 2025) place 2026 in the execution phase for Indian businesses, accelerating the shift towards first-party data, consent-led marketing and privacy-safe measurement
- Real estate, financial services, healthcare and e-commerce continue to be the most active verticals for digital marketing investment in India
- Performance marketing, local SEO and regional-language content are driving incremental growth in Tier II and Tier III markets
- India's digital marketing market and broader digital adoption (UPI transaction volumes, internet user base) provide a structural tailwind for demand

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Deepen practice in Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) to position clients for discoverability in an AI-mediated search environment, alongside continued investment in core SEO/performance marketing fundamentals
- Leverage cross-vertical expertise spanning real estate, senior living, retail, hospitality and technology to align with the sectors driving India's digital marketing growth
- Focus on data-driven, outcome-oriented campaigns with measurable ROI and transparent attribution as client evaluation shifts from awareness-based to outcome-based marketing
- Position as an agency able to guide clients through compliant, first-party data strategies as the DPDP Act framework matures, seen as a source of competitive advantage
- Continue investing in capability and deepening client partnerships rather than chasing platform/metric trends

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: As an asset-light digital marketing agency, ODigMa's expansion narrative centres on service-line and geographic footprint rather than physical capacity. During the year, the Company incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary, Odigma FZE LLC, in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates (incorporated August 13, 2025) as an international expansion step; the subsidiary was yet to commence business operations as of March 31, 2026. Domestically, the Company continues to broaden its service portfolio into Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and flags Tier II/III vernacular markets as a growth opportunity, but no named capex projects, plant/site additions, or capacity-expansion timelines are disclosed.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- 16+ years of operating track record (founded 2010 in Bengaluru) with 150+ client relationships built across industries
- 120+ skilled professionals and a stated culture of collaboration, curiosity and accountability positioned as a talent/service-quality differentiator
- Early, deepening investment in Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) to position clients for discoverability on AI-driven search platforms ahead of the shift away from traditional search
- Diversified sector exposure across seven end-markets (real estate, healthcare, food & beverage, e-commerce, manufacturing, education, finance), reducing reliance on any single industry
- Strategic shift from external contracting to in-house capability build (contracting expense fell from 73.98% to 64.91% of revenue in FY2025-26), aimed at improving gross margin and long-term operating control

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Cost-pressure driven loss — An increase in the cost of services, employee benefit expenses, and other operating expenses drove the Company from a profit after tax of Rs. 38.99 lakhs in FY2024-25 to a loss after tax of Rs. 108.31 lakhs in FY2025-26, indicating margin sensitivity to cost inflation in a people-intensive service model.
- Talent retention in a competitive hiring environment — The Company describes its employees as its key strength and differentiator and operates 'in a highly competitive environment,' making attraction, development and retention of skilled digital-marketing talent a structural dependency for service delivery.
- Key managerial personnel transition — The Chief Financial Officer role changed hands within the year (Ms. Guddi Bharatbhai Chauhan stepped down effective March 26, 2026; Ms. Saumya Milanbhai Yagnik was appointed CFO w.e.f. March 27, 2026), reflecting turnover risk in a critical management position.
- Unconsolidated, pre-operational overseas subsidiary — The newly incorporated wholly-owned subsidiary, Odigma FZE LLC (Sharjah, UAE), had not commenced business operations and had no audited financial statements as of March 31, 2026; consequently the Company did not prepare consolidated financial statements for FY2025-26, limiting visibility into the international expansion.
